quests.title: The Dead Patch at Ashfield
quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. The number three green at Ashfield has had a bald patch the shape of Tasmania since a public holiday nobody remembered, and the committee thinks I am inventing it. Half the street knows and half the street is pretending not to. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: the patch, with something in frame for scale
bring it to me before the meeting

quests.title: Turf Money, Ashfield
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. They have seen the photograph and now they want it re-laid by a public holiday nobody remembered, which means finding $52 that the Ashfield club does not have. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. I will owe you one, and I pay those.

steps.label: $52, however you like, I am not asking
put it in my hand, not the safe

quests.title: The Ashfield Membership Count
quests.blurb: Keep it between us for now. Our books say 93 members at Ashfield and I would bet the bar takings that half of them are dead or moved to Queensland. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: stand at the side door where the list is kept
the board with the names still on it
read me the ones you did not recognise

quests.title: Closing Time Rumour, Ashfield
quests.blurb: Right. Since you asked. Since two in the afternoon somebody has been going round the Ashfield greens telling the barefoot bowlers we are shutting, and we are not shutting. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. There's cash in it. Not a lot.

steps.label: whoever is doing the telling
and take the bar money off them while you are there

quests.title: Behind the Bar at Ashfield
quests.blurb: My knees are gone, so. There is a docket book in the chest freezer behind the bar at Ashfield and I am not opening it on an empty stomach. This is the third time I have had this conversation. You'll know it when you see it.

steps.label: get one into you first, seriously
round the back where the cellar door is
whatever is in there, before I lose my nerve

quests.title: The Old Greenkeeper, Ashfield
quests.blurb: This is going to sound small. The man who kept these greens before me drinks at Summer Hill now, and he owes Ashfield an explanation about the drainage. It started small, the way these things do. Half now if you want it. Most people don't.

steps.label: find him and hear him out
come back and tell me what he said

quests.title: Nights at Woy Woy
quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. Every night around the second express the same car does three laps of the Woy Woy forecourt and never buys fuel. Half the street knows and half the street is pretending not to. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: the car, plate if you can get it
I want it on record before I ring anyone

quests.title: The Third Lap, Woy Woy
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. Now I know the plate, I want to know where it goes after it leaves Woy Woy at the second express, because it is not going home. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. I will owe you one, and I pay those.

steps.label: follow it as far as Koolewong
wherever it stops

quests.title: Bay Two, Woy Woy
quests.blurb: Keep it between us for now. Bay two at the Woy Woy workshop has had the same car in it since a Tuesday and the owner has stopped answering. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: the address on the job card
the letterbox, so I know I have the right house
tell me if anybody actually lives there

quests.title: Tools Off the Bench, Woy Woy
quests.blurb: Right. Since you asked. Someone has been walking out of Woy Woy with a socket set at a time since a Tuesday, and I have run out of ways to be polite about it. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. There's cash in it. Not a lot.

steps.label: the ones hanging round the air hose
$51 of it back, that is what the set cost

quests.title: The Woy Woy Price Board
quests.blurb: My knees are gone, so. Head office says the Woy Woy board has been wrong since a Tuesday and I say it has been right for eleven years, and one of us is about to be embarrassed. This is the third time I have had this conversation. You'll know it when you see it.

steps.label: buy something so it is a real transaction
the board and the pump, both in the one shot
that settles it either way

quests.title: The Other Franchise, Woy Woy
quests.blurb: This is going to sound small. The bloke who runs the site at Tascott has had the same trouble Woy Woy has, and he will talk to you before he talks to me. It started small, the way these things do. Half now if you want it. Most people don't.

steps.label: find him on shift
whatever he says, I want it word for word

quests.title: Level Two, Villawood
quests.blurb: There is no clever way to say this. Water has been coming through the level two ceiling of the Villawood block since the long weekend and the strata report says there is no water. Half the street knows and half the street is pretending not to. Do that and we're square.

steps.label: the ceiling, with the stain visible
that goes in the file whether they like it or not

quests.title: The Special Levy, Villawood
quests.blurb: You look like you have twenty minutes. The photo did it. I am not after trouble. I am after an answer. Now every owner at Villawood owes $61 and I have to collect it from people who have avoided me for a year. I will owe you one, and I pay those.

steps.label: $61 out of them, in any state
I will not ask how

quests.title: Car Space 14, Villawood
quests.blurb: Keep it between us for now. Somebody who does not live at Villawood has parked in space fourteen every night since the long weekend and the manager will not look at it. Nobody else seems to have noticed, which is its own problem. Do not let them talk you into anything.

steps.label: down to the basement, the far corner
the car in the space with the number painted beside it

quests.title: The Meeting, Villawood
quests.blurb: Right. Since you asked. The Villawood AGM is on the long weekend and I would like to arrive with something stronger than a grievance and a printout. Everyone I have told has looked at me the way you are now. There's cash in it. Not a lot.

steps.label: two coffees, one is for me
the community room where they hold it
walk in with me, they behave when there is a witness

quests.title: Bin Night at Villawood
quests.blurb: My knees are gone, so. Three units at Villawood have put their bins out on the wrong night since the long weekend and I have taken it personally, which I accept is a choice I made. This is the third time I have had this conversation. You'll know it when you see it.

steps.label: the ones who argue about it
the fine the council gave me, off them

quests.title: The Other Block, Villawood
quests.blurb: This is going to sound small. There is a block at Carramar with the same builder and the same cracks, and their manager has already been through what Villawood is starting. It started small, the way these things do. Half now if you want it. Most people don't.

steps.label: go and ask them how it ended
I need to know how much worse this gets
